title: Complex localization of the open composition square
statement:
For any complex I, the h-localization unit on the open-image complex followed by Rh_* of its open-image localization and the canonical open comparison equals Q of the image component, the open-image localization on h_*I, and Rj_W applied to the explicit restriction-localization chain followed by the inverse derived restriction comparison. This is the composition equation before the restriction chain is normalized. Its proof postcomposes the open-composition normalization by the inverse comparison; it does not use the restriction unit normalization, K-injectivity or e. Definitions: [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-restriction-localization-chain], [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Exact Lean statement:
theorem schemeMV_image_composition_localization
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let F := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let R := schemeDerivedDirectImage W.ι
    (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization h).app (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map (schemeMVOpenImageLocalization X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W) I) ≫
      (schemeMVOpenComparison h W (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).hom =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeMVImageComponent h W I (F.obj I) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      schemeMVOpenImageLocalization Y W (F.obj I) ≫
      R.map (schemeMVRestrictionLocalizationChain X Y h W I ≫
        (schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison h W).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))

proof.text: Apply the core composition identity, which supplies the same composite with the explicit restriction-localization chain followed by the inverse derived restriction comparison as two separate factors.

Unfold the lets and use functoriality of the derived direct-image functor, rewriting map of a composite as the composite of maps and reassociating composition. This yields the target's single mapped composite.
